scope: 20 named/individual minor options, with four major-specific Business Administration variants. Transcribed from the 2025-26 providing-school catalog plus the November 2025 Leadership supplement.

schemaExplanation.requirements: Each object is one required course or one choice slot; repeated choices with a shared groupId must be distinct. Use actual selected course credits, not a fixed 3-SCH placeholder.
schemaExplanation.variants: Business Administration requires selecting exactly one eligiblePrograms variant. Parent requirements is intentionally empty.
schemaExplanation.eligibility: eligiblePrograms null means no exhaustive allowed-major list is asserted; excludedPrograms are explicit catalog exclusions. overlapReviewPrograms is a planning concern, not an invented institutional ban.
schemaExplanation.reviewRequired: True means a conflict or required approval blocks claiming that the minor is finalized. Still allow a reviewable draft with the literal requirements.
schemaExplanation.source: file/page and compatibility filename/pdfPage keys identify the supplied PDF, with PDF page numbers matching the printed pages.
schemaExplanation.credits: Declared/listed intended total; conflicts may distinguish literal table sums. Prerequisite courses outside the minor add actual plan load but not minor credits.
schemaExplanation.programRules: Apply only when its condition is met. Replacement placeholders require a factual option or an approved substitution. Never silently double-count major/GenEd courses.
schemaExplanation.advancedOptionLists: CSC33xx/43xx choices expand only to actual catalog records with explicit 3-SCH entries; pattern labels are never fabricated course records.

integrationPolicy.bbaSecondConcentration: BBA students who choose a second concentration are not required to take a minor (November 2025 sheet p9). Do not stack both without an explicit student choice.
integrationPolicy.computingOutsideMajor: All three computing degrees require a minor outside Computing (catalog pp172,175,182).
integrationPolicy.globalOverlapEvidence: Catalog p120 explicitly prohibits major/Individual-Minor overlap within the Individual Minors subsection. It does not expressly state a universal named-minor rule there. All SSE named minors explicitly require credits beyond the major. Named SSAH/SBA minor general major/GenEd overlap is not fully specified by these source pages.
integrationPolicy.safeDraftRule: Count a physical course once. When a selected named minor overlaps another requirement and no explicit double-fulfillment or substitution rule is available, preserve the other requirement, add an approved-replacement placeholder in the minor, and require advisor review. Label this conservative GoPlan treatment, not an asserted blanket AUI regulation.

explicitGenEdRestrictions.rule: Must count toward minor. Use HIS1301, HIS2301, HUM1310 or HUM2302 for the GenEd requirement.

integrationPolicy.declarationDeadline: Declare major/concentration/minor no later than the beginning of the semester enrolling in the 60th SCH; catalog p119.
integrationPolicy.noOfferingPromise: A catalog listing is not evidence a course will run in a particular term. Only Biotechnology and LDI sequence terms are explicitly stated here; all other availability needs a course-offering check.
